### The difference we make

With Scandit, businesses can speed up scanning workflows by 5x on any smart device, like smartphones, handheld computers, fixed cameras, and drones. Such innovation drives cost savings, employee retention, and customer loyalty.

We partner with customers at every step with trials, solution design, integration, and customer success support included, helping organizations transform digitally now and innovate for the future.

[Business results](https://www.scandit.com/company/business-results/) [Explore case studies](https://www.scandit.com/resources/customer-stories/)

![](https://assets.scandit.com/1280x853/48e7ec6633/scandit-co-founders-2022.jpg/m/600x0/smart/filters:quality(80):format(jpeg))

### Our story

Scandit, founded in 2009 by three researchers from MIT, ETH Zurich, and IBM Research, quickly evolved into a software business that places powerful data capture capabilities into the hands of workers and customers, blending the physical and digital worlds.

Today, we are the leader in [smart data capture](https://www.scandit.com/smart-data-capture/). Our team of global experts partner with customers, integrating data capture into workflows and providing actionable insights.

[Meet the leadership team](https://www.scandit.com/management/)
